description: This Java class implements a Quartz JobListener that tracks the execution of scheduled jobs, sets tenant context appropriately, and records job execution status and logs to the database.

classes.name: SchedulerJobListener
classes.description: A Quartz JobListener that manages tenant context and logs execution details of scheduled jobs, including success or failure and error logs.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the JobListener.

methods.name: jobToBeExecuted
methods.description: Callback invoked before a job is executed; currently does nothing.

methods.name: jobExecutionVetoed
methods.description: Callback invoked if a job execution is vetoed; currently does nothing.

methods.name: jobWasExecuted
methods.description: Callback invoked after a job has executed; handles tenant context setting, logs success or failure details, and updates job run history.

methods.name: getCauseFromException
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the root cause from a nested exception, respecting a maximum stack trace level.
